positive.prompt: Here are my review comments on your PR — go through them
The reviewer says your change breaks the API — check and respond
I left 6 comments on the diff, fix them

negative.prompt: Review this pull request across correctness and security

evals.prompt: A reviewer commented on your PR: "This endpoint is unused, remove it." The endpoint is actually called by the CLI. Respond.
evals.expected_output: A reasoned pushback citing the call site, or a removal after verifying actual usage
expectations: The agent checks actual usage before agreeing or removing
No performative agreement ("you're absolutely right") appears
The reply is a technical argument or an action, not a social pleasantry
